## Claims affected

- [ ] New or changed factual prose has stable claim IDs.
- [ ] Sources are registered and traceable.
- [ ] Evidence status matches the source strength.
- [ ] Interpretation is separate from fact.
- [ ] “What this does not prove” is explicit.
- [ ] Material changes include a correction/revision note.
